name: La Reconquista 2010

description.spanish: El Mod La Reconquista (2010) de JVLIVS CAESAR, que sirvió de base al MCI: reequilibra las civilizaciones del juego (unidades, héroes, costes, fortines) y añade arqueros de arco largo, guardias de fortín, capitanes, barcos propios de cada pueblo y rangos de héroe. Cada civilización del mod va aparte, junto a la del juego ("Galos (Reconq.)", "Roma rep. (Reconq.)"…): la del juego no se modifica.
description.english: JVLIVS CAESAR's La Reconquista mod (2010), the base of the MCI: it rebalances the game's civilizations (units, heroes, costs, outposts) and adds longbowmen, outpost guards, captains, a navy of its own for each people and hero ranks. Each civilization of the mod is its own, next to the game's ("Gaul (Reconq.)", "Rep. Rome (Reconq.)"…): the game's ones are not changed.
